name: agri-node-poe-core
description: Shared base for M5Stack ATOM PoE sensor / relay nodes that feed OGMS and UECS-CCM. Bundles ESP-IDF-lwIP-backed W5500 setup, NVS config, embedded HTTP UI, MQTT and UECS-CCM publishers, mDNS/OTA, and a status LED state machine.
keywords: agriculture, ogms, uecs, ccm, m5stack, atom, poe, w5500, mqtt, mdns
